Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 19

“The wise call that one learned whose every undertaking is free of desire and design, whose actions are burnt up in the fire of knowledge.”

The criterion is stated as an absence — no desire propelling the start of things. Knowledge is pictured as a fire consuming the residue that action would otherwise leave.
